prompts.seated: Use case: compositing. Create ONE reverse-camera master seating shot of existing classroom scene. INPUT1 is EXACT CAMERA/BACKGROUND EDIT TARGET: classroom looking toward WHITEBOARD and teacher desk/coat rack. Preserve input1 camera, room architecture, white central table, blue chairs, monitors, furniture, lighting and 1536x1024 framing. INPUT2 is SAME CLASSROOM WITH FIVE STUDENTS viewed from OPPOSITE END looking toward windows, used to preserve student identities, physical seats and poses. Rotate CAMERA by 180 degrees relative to input2, do not rearrange physical seating. REQUIRED SEATING in OUTPUT using input1 camera: RIGHT side nearest camera = BEIGE HOODIE student with shoulder-length center-part light-brown hair and blue pen; RIGHT middle = GREY ZIP HOODIE student shaggy brown hair red-grey shirt graphic; RIGHT farthest toward board = DAMIR black shaggy hair, rectangular glasses, cream T-shirt, backpack on chair. LEFT side nearest camera = EMPTY CHAIR; LEFT middle = ELAMAN buzzcut green pixel-face shirt grey sweatpants wooden beads; LEFT farthest toward board = BAKHYTZHAN short dark hair charcoal blazer white shirt, arms crossed leaning back. Both table end chairs remain empty. Exactly FIVE seated young adult students, no teacher. Preserve physical body poses from input2 as seen from reverse side: Damir hands clasped on table, grey hoodie forearms and hands clasped tabletop, beige hoodie blue pen in hands, Elaman forearm tabletop other on lap, blazer arms crossed leaning back and feet on floor. Students face inward and generally toward whiteboard end; see believable reverse three-quarter SIDE/BACK views, not all turning to face camera. Maintain recognizable hair/clothing and some natural face profiles; don't put anyone facing outward from table. Natural hips in existing seats and feet under table, correct perspective scale. Established polished illustrated visual novel character rendering matching input2 and room light. No extra people, no duplication, no text/labels/UI/watermark. CRITICAL: right-side order beige NEAR, grey MIDDLE, glasses FAR; left side green MIDDLE, blazer FAR, nearest left EMPTY.
